# TaskFlow Approval System - Backend Java Application
A comprehensive Spring Boot application for managing request workflows with multi-level approvals, supporting roles, request types, and comprehensive audit trails.
## Project Overview
This backend application implements a complete workflow management system with: - Multi-level approval chains - Role-based access control - Request lifecycle management - Comprehensive audit logging - Swagger API documentation
## ️ Architecture
### Tech Stack - **Framework**: Spring Boot 3.2.0 - **Build Tool**: Maven - **Database**: MySQL 8.0+ - **ORM**: JPA/Hibernate - **Testing**: JUnit 5 + Mockito - **API Documentation**: Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0 - **Java Version**: 17
### Project Structure ``` TaskFlow_Approval_System/ ├── src/main/java/com/taskflow/approvalsystem/ │ ├── entity/ # JPA entities │ │ ├── User.java │ │ ├── Request.java │ │ ├── ApprovalStep.java │ │ └── AuditLog.java │ ├── enums/ # Enumeration types │ │ ├── Role.java (EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, FINANCE, ADMIN) │ │ ├── RequestType.java (LEAVE, EXPENSE, ACCESS, ASSET) │ │ ├── RequestStatus.java (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED) │ │ ├── ApprovalStatus.java (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED) │ │ └── AuditAction.java (CREATE, UPDATE, SUBMIT, APPROVE, REJECT, CANCEL) │ ├── repository/ # Spring Data JPA repositories │ │ ├── UserRepository.java │ │ ├── RequestRepository.java │ │ ├── ApprovalStepRepository.java │ │ └── AuditLogRepository.java │ ├── service/ # Business logic │ │ ├── UserService.java │ │ └── RequestService.java │ ├── controller/ # REST controllers │ │ ├── UserController.java │ │ ├── RequestController.java │ │ └── AuditController.java │ ├── config/ # Configuration │ │ ├── SecurityConfig.java │ │ └── OpenApiConfig.java │ └── TaskFlowApprovalSystemApplication.java ├── src/test/java/com/taskflow/approvalsystem/service/ │ ├── UserServiceTest.java # 5 unit tests │ └── RequestServiceTest.java # 12 unit tests ├── pom.xml # Maven configuration └── README.md ```
## Core Entities
### User - Roles: EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, FINANCE, ADMIN - Relationships: Employees have managers - Validation: Unique email, valid role assignment
### Request - Types: LEAVE, EXPENSE, ACCESS, ASSET - Status: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED - Type-specific fields: amount (expense/asset), dates (leave)
### ApprovalStep - Sequential workflow steps - Assigned to users by role - Status tracking (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED) - Comments and timestamps
### AuditLog - Tracks all lifecycle actions - Immutable records - Timestamps and user tracking
## Workflow Rules
### Leave Request - Manager approval only
### Expense Request - Amount ≤ 50k: Manager - Amount > 50k: Manager → Finance
### Access Request - Manager → Admin
### Asset Request - Amount ≤ 100k: Manager - Amount > 100k: Manager → Finance → Admin
## Functional Requirements
| FR# | Requirement | Status | |-----|-------------|--------| | FR-01 | User Creation with validation | ✅ | | FR-02 | Create Request in DRAFT | ✅ | | FR-03 | Update Draft Requests | ✅ | | FR-04 | Submit Request with workflow | ✅ | | FR-05 | Multi-level approval rules | ✅ | | FR-06 | Approve in sequence | ✅ | | FR-07 | Reject with comments | ✅ | | FR-08 | Cancel requests | ✅ | | FR-09 | View pending approvals | ✅ | | FR-10 | Search with filters | ✅ | | FR-11 | Audit logging | ✅ | | FR-12 | Reports & aggregates | ✅ |
## Testing
### Test Coverage: 17/17 Tests (100% Pass Rate)
**UserServiceTest** (5 tests) - User creation and validation - Email uniqueness enforcement - Manager requirement validation - User retrieval by ID and email
**RequestServiceTest** (12 tests) - Request creation and submission - Workflow rule enforcement - Approval step processing - Rejection flow - Status transitions - Cancellation restrictions - Draft updates - Mandatory field validation
### Running Tests ```bash # Run all tests mvn test
# Run specific test class mvn test -Dtest=RequestServiceTest
# Run with coverage report mvn clean test jacoco:report ```
## Getting Started
### Prerequisites - Java 17 or higher - Maven 3.6+ - MySQL 8.0+
### Database Setup 1. Install MySQL 8.0+ 2. Create a database named `taskflow_db` 3. Update `src/main/resources/application.properties` with your MySQL credentials: ```properties spring.datasource.username=your_mysql_username spring.datasource.password=your_mysql_password ```
### Installation ```bash cd TaskFlow_Approval_System mvn clean install ```
### Running the Application ```bash mvn spring-boot:run ```
The application starts on `http://localhost:8080`
### Access Swagger UI ``` http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui/index.html ```
### Default Sample Users (Created on Startup) - **Manager**: John Manager (manager@example.com) - Role: MANAGER - **Employee**: Jane Employee (employee@example.com) - Role: EMPLOYEE - **Finance**: Finance User (finance@example.com) - Role: FINANCE - **Admin**: Admin User (admin@example.com) - Role: ADMIN
## REST APIs
### User APIs ``` POST /api/users # Create user GET /api/users # Get all users GET /api/users/{id} # Get user by ID ```
### Request APIs ``` POST /api/requests # Create request PUT /api/requests/{id} # Update draft request POST /api/requests/{id}/submit # Submit request POST /api/requests/{id}/approve # Approve step POST /api/requests/{id}/reject # Reject step POST /api/requests/{id}/cancel # Cancel request GET /api/requests/pending # Get pending approvals GET /api/requests # Get requests ```
### Audit APIs ``` GET /api/audit/request/{requestId} # Get audit logs ```
## Security
- CSRF protection disabled for API endpoints - Role-based authorization enforced in business logic - Email uniqueness validated - Requester-only submission enforced - Approver-only approval enforced
## API Examples
### Create User ```bash curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/users?name=John%20Doe&email=john@example.com&role=MANAGER&department=Sales&managerId=" ```
### Create Request ```bash curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/requests?title=Leave%20Request&description=Annual%20Leave&type=LEAVE&requesterId=2&startDateStr=01052026&endDateStr=10052026" ```
### Submit Request ```bash curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/requests/1/submit?userId=2" ```
### Approve Step ```bash curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/api/requests/1/approve?userId=1&comments=Approved" ```
## Documentation
- **TEST_SUMMARY.md**: Detailed test coverage documentation - **TESTING_REPORT.md**: Complete testing report with metrics - **API Documentation**: Available at `/swagger-ui/index.html`
## Database Schema
### Users Table - id (PK), name, email (unique), role, department, manager_id (FK), created_at, updated_at
### Requests Table - id (PK), title, description, type, status, requester_id (FK), amount, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at
### ApprovalSteps Table - id (PK), request_id (FK), step_order, approver_id (FK), status, comments, approved_at
### AuditLogs Table - id (PK), request_id (FK), user_id (FK), action, timestamp, details
## Next Steps
1. **Authentication**: Add JWT-based authentication 2. **Database**: Migrate to PostgreSQL for production 3. **Validation**: Add comprehensive input validation 4. **Error Handling**: Add custom error handling and responses 5. **Pagination**: Implement pagination for search results 6. **Caching**: Add caching layer for performance 7. **Notifications**: Add email notifications for approvals 8. **Analytics**: Add reporting and analytics features
## Support
For issues or questions, please refer to the project documentation or contact the development team.
## License
This project is part of the TaskFlow suite and follows the organization's licensing policies.
---
